items.sum: The Madras High Court issued interim injunctions on October 13, 2026, to prevent the unauthorised online streaming of Rajinikanth-starrer Jailer 2 and the Shivarajkumar-starrer Bail. Justice P.B. Balaji acted on suits filed by copyright holders Sun TV Network Limited and KVN Productions LLP to stop digital piracy. Counsel Rahul Balaji noted that pirates often exhibit movies within 30 minutes of release, prompting the court to order an early web copy for telecom and cable operators. Jailer 2, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, is scheduled for release on October 15, 2026. Meanwhile, the Kannada film Bail, directed by Pavan Wadeyar, arrived in theatres on October 2, 2026.

New cast additions include S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Vidya Balan, and Jatin Sarna.
